**"every literal relative require()"**: The regex only matches `./` or `../` paths in `'` or `"` quotes. It misses template literals, `require.resolve`, and anything under the skipped `node_modules` and `target` directories.

**"in a shipped .js"**: The script also scans test files. It reports them separately as a count. "Shipped" really means "not `*.test.js`", so `*.spec.js` and `__tests__/` files still count as shipped. `.cjs` and `.mjs` files aren't scanned at all.

**"crashes at load"**: This isn't established. A `require` inside a function, behind a condition, or in a `try/catch` won't crash at load. Only a run against a real tree, or a test that loads one of the flagged files, would back this up.
